d:
W ( ) rasili Paneer Bhurji, masaledar tomato gravy aur ghi-makkhan ka zabardast svad! hare matar, kasuri methi aur freshly crumbled paneer ka aisa combination ki har bite bane khasa. garma-garam Roti ya Ladi Pav ke sath ekdam perfect!
Preparation time 10 minutes
Cooking time 25-30 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Paste
4 large Tomatoes (cut into half), tamatar
1 inch Ginger (peeled & roughly sliced), adrak
